claims.subject: relationship--blackoasis--mitre--fb084d2d740a47ff
claims.statement: BlackOasis related-to NEODYMIUM: (Citation: Securelist BlackOasis Oct 2017) (Citation: Securelist APT Trends Q2 2017) A group known by Microsoft as [NEODYMIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0055) is reportedly associated closely with [BlackOasis](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0063) operations, but evidence that the group names are aliases has not been identified.
claims.verification_rationale: MITRE relationship extraction: status=partially-supported; A narrative cross-reference establishes a relationship but does not by itself prove exact actor identity or identical scope.
